{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of September–December 2009. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 6.1''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards as of [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV]], the first release after the [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]. Reflections IV has official text as of 4 September 2009, and the Players Committee announced it, with the Revolution Errata and the realignment of the earlier Virtual Sets, on 16 September 2009.<ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="hp2009">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (news item "Virtual Set 6: Reflections 4 and Errata Released (Updated)", 16 September 2009, and "standard playing format" text). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 18 September 2009]</ref> No separate tournament-legal date was found. The pool lasted until 20 December 2009; Virtual Block 6.2 became legal on 21 December.<ref name="news83">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=83 Virtual Set 6.2 is released], Players Committee (7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222734/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=83 Internet Archive]</ref> At the time the Players Committee simply called this its standard format: "our standard playing format, which is open deck construction where all cards in the card pool are available for use".<ref name="hp2009" /> Event listings of the time call it "Constructed" or "Open Constructed".<ref name="cal2009nov">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (event calendar). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091125230344/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 25 November 2009]</ref><ref name="cal2009dec">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (event calendar). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091223054500/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 23 December 2009]</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–5 and Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV)
* '''In use:''' 16 September 2009 – 20 December 2009 (no separate tournament-legal date for 6.1 was found)
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61" /> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>

Changes made while this pool was in force:

* 21 September 2009: Rebel Fleet (V) from Reflections IV was temporarily blanked and Strong Is Vader received errata, both effective immediately.<ref name="news72">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=72 Strong Is Vader / Rebel Fleet changes], Players Committee (21 September 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=72 Internet Archive]</ref>
* 21 October 2009: the errata of Leia, Rebel Princess was revised to a bottom template only, effective immediately.<ref name="news77">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=77 Errata Revision for Leia, Rebel Princess], Players Committee (21 October 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222723/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=77 Internet Archive]</ref>

== History ==
The previous pool was [[Premiere - Original VS17]], with the numbered Virtual Sets 1–17. On 16 September 2009 the Players Committee announced "the completion of Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV, as well as the completion of the Revolution Errata" and a "realignment of the existing virtual sets, into larger sets that are more consolidated": Virtual Set 1: A New Hope, 2: The Empire Strikes Back, 3: Return of the Jedi, 4: Expanded Universe and 5: The Old Republic.<ref name="hp2009" /> The repackaged Block 1–5 PDFs carry the stamp "Official text as of December 7, 2009"; they hold no new cards.<ref name="vb1" /> The cards of the planned 18th set, Fifth Anthology, were released inside Reflections IV.<ref name="w-reorg" />

So this pool differs from the previous one by the 110 new Reflections IV cards, the mass Revolution Errata and the new Block numbering.<ref name="w-r4" /><ref name="hp2009" /> Decklists of the [[2009 World Championship]] (8–11 October 2009) already include Reflections IV cards such as [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V)]] and [[Let The Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Let The Wookiee Win (V)]].<ref name="ev-2009 World Championship">Decklists of the [[2009 World Championship]] on this wiki.</ref>

On 28 October 2009 the Players Committee announced the next release, Galaxy At War, for 7 December ("Cards will be tournament legal December 21st").<ref name="news79">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=79 ANNOUNCEMENT: Galaxy At War – Block 1 Release], Players Committee (28 October 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222729/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=79 Internet Archive]</ref> On 5 November it moved Galaxy At War to a later Block and made the 7 December release "a continuation of the V6: Reflections IV block".<ref name="news81">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=81 Virtual Set Release Date revision(s)], Players Committee (5 November 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091126195611/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=81 Internet Archive]</ref> That release became Virtual Block 6.2, [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|Domain Of Evil]].
